POSTECH describes POSTECH AI as a multi-LLM generative AI service for members that includes ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, and says entered user data is designed not to be used for external model retraining.
POSTECH announced an AI-Native University initiative with Microsoft and described it as integrating AI across admissions, student education, research, and administration.
POSTECH says it discussed data security, data sovereignty, operating structure, scalability, and governance before later implementation tasks including POSTECH AI.
